Still Waters is a 500-piece puzzle of a lone fisherman on a calm, reflective lake, surrounded by a brilliant cascade of color. Put the phone in another room and give your hands something slower to do.

It's made for nature lovers, outdoor fans and anyone who wants a quiet hour back. Work the reflections one section at a time, then frame it when the last piece is in.

Goodnight Glow is a 100-piece puzzle of a little girl gently blowing out her candle for the night, with soft golden light on her curls, her pajamas and her nightstand. It's soulful, Afrocentric art painted in rich, expressive brushstrokes.

The 100 pieces make it a good fit for kids, beginners and quick sessions, so bring it out for a family puzzle night or wrap it up as a thoughtful gift. Once it's finished, it's ready to frame.
